changelog: The AI agent now controls EVERY Achiva feature, not just the subject tracker: Tasks (bulk add, bulk tick by name, edit, delete), Goals (create with date windows, progress tasks, session logging), Habits (good/bad with one-click / time-slot / timer types, one-call daily logging, defend & slip tracking), Thoughts (knowledge-graph categories + links), Focus Shield (blocking rules, strict levels, service start/stop) and Draw boards (canvases + cards)

SPEED: the agent's toolset was consolidated to 40 leaner tools — bulk operations finish in ONE call (a whole day's tasks, a full syllabus, all daily habits), one generic update/delete covers everything, and get_state has a compact light mode — every action now needs fewer round trips and far fewer tokens
Deletes stay SAFE by design: every delete is two-step — first call only previews, the agent must ask you in chat, and only then can it delete with confirm=true

KaTeX fix: formulas in topic notes now render even when the math libraries load late (slow network) — the open Read view re-renders automatically the moment rendering is ready, and the libraries now load in parallel with the app instead of at the end of the boot chain
